premise: Down in the grass Caterpillar can't see the sky; Deer lowers his head and lifts her up high, and there is the whole sky — where Butterfly says she'll fly one day, as Butterfly was a caterpillar once too.
inspiration: The frog in the well (Chinese fable), who thinks the sky is only as big as the well's mouth; turned: a friend lifts you up to see the big world, and another shows you who you'll become.
lesson: Friends help us see further than we can alone.
learning: Caterpillars grow up to become butterflies.

en-US.title: Caterpillar Sees the Sky
en-US.text: Down in the grass lived {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar. Grass to the left. Grass to the right. {sfx:grass} Grass, grass, grass. {butterfly:enter} Butterfly fluttered high above. [curious] "What's up there?" asked Caterpillar. {butterfly:live talk} "The sky!" {caterpillar:face sad} So Caterpillar {caterpillar:live reach-up} stretched and stretched. Still only grass. Along came {deer:enter} {deer:go to caterpillar} Deer, on his long, careful legs, and saw her stretching. {deer:live graze} He bent his head down low, right beside her. [gently] "Climb on," said Deer. {caterpillar:go on deer} Up she climbed, and up… up… up went his head. {canvas:clouds 0.4} {caterpillar:face surprised} [in awe] There it was. The sky! Big and blue, with white clouds sailing by. {caterpillar:live look-up hold} Caterpillar reared up tall and gazed. {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go on deer} Butterfly {sfx:flutter} fluttered down and landed beside her. {butterfly:live rest} She rested her wings. [warmly] "One day you'll fly up there," she said. "Me? I can't fly!" "I couldn't either," said Butterfly. "I was a caterpillar once, just like you." {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Caterpillar wiggled all over. {caterpillar:face happy} {deer:face happy} {deer:hearts} [softly] "See you soon, sky," she whispered. {canvas:clouds stop}

es-ES.title: Oruga descubre el cielo
es-ES.text: Allá abajo, entre la hierba, vivía {caterpillar:enter} Oruga. Hierba a la izquierda. Hierba a la derecha. {sfx:grass} Hierba, hierba y más hierba. {butterfly:enter} Mariposa revoloteaba muy por encima. [curious] —¿Qué hay ahí arriba? —preguntó Oruga. {butterfly:live talk} —¡El cielo! {caterpillar:face sad} Así que Oruga {caterpillar:live reach-up} se estiró y se estiró. Solo hierba. Entonces llegó {deer:enter} {deer:go to caterpillar} Ciervo, con sus patas largas y cuidadosas, y la vio estirándose. {deer:live graze} Bajó la cabeza hasta la hierba, justo a su lado. [gently] —Sube —le dijo. {caterpillar:go on deer} Oruga trepó, y Ciervo fue levantando la cabeza despacito: arriba… arriba… ¡arriba! {canvas:clouds 0.4} {caterpillar:face surprised} [in awe] ¡Allí estaba el cielo! Grande y azul, con nubes blancas que pasaban despacio. {caterpillar:live look-up hold} Oruga se estiró bien alta para mirarlo. {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go on deer} Mariposa bajó {sfx:flutter} revoloteando y se posó a su lado. {butterfly:live rest} Y plegó las alas. [warmly] —Algún día volarás ahí arriba —le dijo. —¿Yo? ¡Pero si no sé volar! —Yo tampoco sabía —dijo Mariposa—. También fui oruga, como tú. {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Oruga se meneó enterita. {caterpillar:face happy} {deer:face happy} {deer:hearts} [softly] —Hasta pronto, cielo —susurró. {canvas:clouds stop}

ja-JP.title: あおむしさん、おそらを 見る
ja-JP.text: くさのなかに、{caterpillar:enter}あおむしさんがすんでいました。ひだりも、くさ。みぎも、くさ。{sfx:grass}くさ、くさ、くさ。{butterfly:enter}チョウチョさんが、ずっと上をひらひら。[curious]「上には、なにがあるの？」 {butterfly:live talk}「おそらよ！」 {caterpillar:face sad}あおむしさんは、{caterpillar:live reach-up}うーんと、うーんとのびました。それでも、くさばかり。そこへ{deer:enter}{deer:go to caterpillar}子ジカが、長い足でそっとやってきて、{deer:live graze}あたまを、すぐそばまでさげました。[gently]「のって。」 {caterpillar:go on deer}あおむしさんがのると、あたまが上へ…上へ…上へ。{canvas:clouds 0.4}{caterpillar:face surprised}[in awe]ありました。おそらです！大きくて、あおくて、白いくもがながれていきます。{caterpillar:live look-up hold}あおむしさんは、のびあがって、じーっ。{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:go on deer}チョウチョさんが{sfx:flutter}ひらひらおりてきて、となりにとまりました。{butterfly:live rest}はねをやすめて、[warmly]「いつか、あなたもあそこをとぶのよ。」 「わたしが？とべないよ！」 「わたしも、とべなかった。むかしは、あなたとおなじ、あおむしだったの。」 {caterpillar:live look-up resume}あおむしさんは、からだじゅうでくねくね。{caterpillar:face happy}{deer:face happy}{deer:hearts}[softly]「またね、おそら」 とささやきました。{canvas:clouds stop}

de-DE.title: Die Raupe sieht den Himmel
de-DE.text: Unten im Gras wohnte {caterpillar:enter} die Raupe. Links Gras. Rechts Gras. {sfx:grass} Gras, Gras, Gras. {butterfly:enter} Der Schmetterling flatterte hoch über ihr. [curious] „Was ist da oben?“, fragte die Raupe. {butterfly:live talk} „Der Himmel!“ {caterpillar:face sad} {caterpillar:live reach-up} Die Raupe streckte sich und streckte sich. Wieder nur Gras. Da stakste {deer:enter} {deer:go to caterpillar} das Reh auf seinen langen Beinen herbei und sah sie sich strecken. {deer:live graze} Es senkte den Kopf tief zu ihr hinunter. [gently] „Steig auf“, sagte das Reh. {caterpillar:go on deer} Sie kletterte hinauf, und das Reh hob den Kopf, hoch… hoch… hoch. {canvas:clouds 0.4} {caterpillar:face surprised} [in awe] Da war er. Der Himmel! Groß und blau, und weiße Wolken segelten vorbei. {caterpillar:live look-up hold} Die Raupe reckte sich und staunte. {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go on deer} Der Schmetterling {sfx:flutter} flatterte herunter und landete neben ihr. {butterfly:live rest} Er klappte die Flügel zu. [warmly] „Eines Tages fliegst du da oben“, sagte er. „Ich? Ich kann doch nicht fliegen!“ „Ich konnte es auch nicht“, sagte der Schmetterling. „Ich war mal eine Raupe, genau wie du.“ {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Die Raupe wackelte vor Freude. {caterpillar:face happy} {deer:face happy} {deer:hearts} [softly] „Bis bald, Himmel“, flüsterte sie. {canvas:clouds stop}

fr-FR.title: Chenille découvre le ciel
fr-FR.text: Tout en bas, dans l’herbe, vivait {caterpillar:enter} Chenille. De l’herbe à gauche. De l’herbe à droite. {sfx:grass} De l’herbe, de l’herbe, de l’herbe. {butterfly:enter} Papillon voletait tout là-haut. [curious] « C’est quoi, là-haut ? » a demandé Chenille. {butterfly:live talk} « Le ciel ! » {caterpillar:face sad} Alors Chenille {caterpillar:live reach-up} s’est étirée, étirée. Toujours de l’herbe. Puis {deer:enter} {deer:go to caterpillar} Faon est arrivé à pas prudents, et il l’a vue s’étirer. {deer:live graze} Il a baissé la tête tout près d’elle. [gently] « Monte », a dit Faon. {caterpillar:go on deer} Elle a grimpé, et la tête de Faon est montée… montée… montée. {canvas:clouds 0.4} {caterpillar:face surprised} [in awe] Le voilà. Le ciel ! Grand et bleu, avec des nuages blancs qui voguaient. {caterpillar:live look-up hold} Chenille s’est dressée pour le contempler. {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go on deer} Papillon est descendu {sfx:flutter} en voletant se poser près d’elle. {butterfly:live rest} Il a reposé ses ailes. [warmly] « Un jour, tu voleras là-haut », a-t-il dit. « Moi ? Mais je ne sais pas voler ! » « Moi non plus, avant ! a dit Papillon. J’étais une chenille, comme toi. » {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Chenille s’est tortillée de partout. {caterpillar:face happy} {deer:face happy} {deer:hearts} [softly] « À bientôt, le ciel », a-t-elle chuchoté. {canvas:clouds stop}

it-IT.title: Bruco scopre il cielo
it-IT.text: Giù nell'erba viveva {caterpillar:enter} Bruco. Erba a sinistra. Erba a destra. {sfx:grass} Erba, erba, erba. {butterfly:enter} Farfalla svolazzava alta alta. [curious] «Che cosa c'è lassù?» ha chiesto Bruco. {butterfly:live talk} «Il cielo!» {caterpillar:face sad} Allora Bruco {caterpillar:live reach-up} si è allungato, allungato. Sempre e solo erba. Poi è arrivato {deer:enter} {deer:go to caterpillar} Cerbiatto, con le sue zampe lunghe e attente, e l'ha visto che si allungava. {deer:live graze} Ha abbassato la testa fino a terra, proprio accanto a lui. [gently] «Sali», ha detto Cerbiatto. {caterpillar:go on deer} Bruco è salito, e Cerbiatto ha alzato la testa piano piano: su… su… su! {canvas:clouds 0.4} {caterpillar:face surprised} [in awe] Eccolo lì. Il cielo! Grande e azzurro, con le nuvole bianche che passavano piano. {caterpillar:live look-up hold} Bruco si è alzato bello dritto e l'ha guardato a lungo. {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go on deer} Farfalla {sfx:flutter} è scesa svolazzando e si è posata accanto a lui. {butterfly:live rest} Ha riposato le ali. [warmly] «Un giorno volerai lassù», gli ha detto. «Io? Ma io non so volare!» «Neanch'io ci riuscivo», ha detto Farfalla. «Una volta ero un bruco, proprio come te.» {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Bruco si è dimenato tutto contento. {caterpillar:face happy} {deer:face happy} {deer:hearts} [softly] «A presto, cielo», ha sussurrato. {canvas:clouds stop}

zh-TW.title: 毛毛蟲看見天空
zh-TW.text: 在草叢深處，住著{caterpillar:enter}毛毛蟲。左邊是草，右邊也是草。{sfx:grass}草、草、草，到處都是草。{butterfly:enter}蝴蝶在高高的上面飛。[curious]「上面有什麼呀？」 毛毛蟲問。{butterfly:live talk}「有天空！」 {caterpillar:face sad}於是毛毛蟲{caterpillar:live reach-up}伸呀伸，伸得好長好長。看到的還是草。這時，{deer:enter}{deer:go to caterpillar}小鹿邁著細細長長的腿，小心翼翼地走過來，看見牠正拚命伸長身體。{deer:live graze}小鹿把頭低低地垂下來，就在牠旁邊。[gently]「爬上來吧。」 小鹿說。{caterpillar:go on deer}毛毛蟲爬了上去，小鹿的頭往上抬……往上……再往上。{canvas:clouds 0.4}{caterpillar:face surprised}[in awe]就在那裡。是天空！又大又藍，白白的雲慢慢飄過去。{caterpillar:live look-up hold}毛毛蟲把身體抬得高高的，看呀看。{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:go on deer}蝴蝶{sfx:flutter}輕輕飛下來，停在牠旁邊。{butterfly:live rest}牠歇了歇翅膀。[warmly]「有一天，你也會飛到那上面去。」 牠說。「我？我不會飛呀！」 「我以前也不會，」 蝴蝶說，「我也當過毛毛蟲，就跟你一樣。」 {caterpillar:live look-up resume}毛毛蟲高興得全身扭來扭去。{caterpillar:face happy}{deer:face happy}{deer:hearts}[softly]「天空，我們很快會再見喔。」 牠小小聲地說。{canvas:clouds stop}

zh-HK.title: 毛毛蟲望見天空
zh-HK.text: 在草叢深處，住着{caterpillar:enter}毛毛蟲。左邊是草，右邊也是草。{sfx:grass}草、草、草，周圍都是草。{butterfly:enter}蝴蝶在高高的上空飛。[curious]「上面有啲乜嘢㗎？」 毛毛蟲問。{butterfly:live talk}「有天空呀！」 {caterpillar:face sad}於是毛毛蟲{caterpillar:live reach-up}伸呀伸，伸得長長的。看見的，還是草。這時，{deer:enter}{deer:go to caterpillar}小鹿用牠長長的腿，一步一步小心地走過來，看見毛毛蟲正拚命伸長身子。{deer:live graze}小鹿把頭垂得低低的，就在牠旁邊。[gently]「爬上嚟啦。」 小鹿說。{caterpillar:go on deer}毛毛蟲爬了上去，小鹿的頭慢慢抬起……向上……再向上。{canvas:clouds 0.4}{caterpillar:face surprised}[in awe]就在那裏。是天空！又大又藍，白雲慢慢地飄過。{caterpillar:live look-up hold}毛毛蟲把身子挺得高高的，看呀看。{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:go on deer}蝴蝶{sfx:flutter}輕輕飛下來，停在牠旁邊。{butterfly:live rest}牠歇了歇翅膀。[warmly]「總有一日，你都會飛上去。」 牠說。「我？我唔識飛㗎！」 「我以前都唔識，」 蝴蝶說，「我以前都係毛毛蟲，同你一模一樣。」 {caterpillar:live look-up resume}毛毛蟲開心得全身扭來扭去。{caterpillar:face happy}{deer:face happy}{deer:hearts}[softly]「天空，我哋好快再見。」 牠輕輕地說。{canvas:clouds stop}

grass.prompt: a soft rustle of tall grass moving gently, realistic field recording
